thread.title: Close Update: Dovish Fed Launches Dow to Eight-Week High

author: MT Newswires
title: Close Update: Dovish Fed Launches Dow to Eight-Week High

organizations.name: dovish fed launches dow to eight-week high shutterstock

text:
Shutterstock photo Assurances from Fed Chairman Jerome Powell that the Federal Reserve was moving to the sidelines coupled with upbeat quarterly results from component stocks Boeing ( BA ) and Apple ( AAPL ) drove the Dow Jones Industrial Average more than 400 points higher and to its best level since early December. The Federal Open Market Committee voted unanimously to keep interest rates unchanged citing an uncertain economic environment and financial disruptions.
Stocks were already off to a strong start when Boeing's upbeat outlook launched the major market averages higher as risk-on conditions improved ahead of what was expected to be a market friendly FOMC meeting.
And the Fed delivered on expectations. Besides language signaling a pause on rate hikes, the Fed reassured the markets that it would alter the pace of its balance sheet reductions, addressing earlier worries that the unwinding of assets was on "auto-pilot." The Fed's statement indicated a desire to maintain "ample" reserves in the banking system, another sign of monetary accommodation.
Economic data was a mixed bag. The private sector added 213,000 new jobs in January -- above the estimated 174,000 -- but pending home sales plummeted 2.2%, driving home sales down by 9.5% year-over-year.
In other earnings news, AT&T ( T ) missed sales estimates bu t report ed earnings that were in-line with expectations; Ebay ( EBAY ) beat on both EPS and revenue estimates; and McDonald's ( MCD ) reported mixed results but issued upbeat sales growth and earnings targets.
The revised interest rate environment drove Treasury securities higher and yields lower with the 10-year note richening to a 2.68% yield and the 2-year to 2.512%. Gold closed higher for a fourth straight day as a result of the weaker dollar, while oil futures were higher but off their best levels of the day.
